+def _solve_jobs(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_ids = None

+    n = len(jobs)

+        chosen = [jobs[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1]

+        ids = {job["id"] for job in chosen}
+        if ids & blocked or not mandatory <= ids:
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(chosen, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["end"] > ordered[i + 1]["start"]
+               for i in range(len(ordered) - 1)):
+            continue
+        names = sorted(ids)
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+        if best_value is None or value > best_value or (value == best_value and names < best_ids):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, names
+    if best_ids is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
